title: SegMamba
paper_title: SegMamba: Long-range Sequential Modeling Mamba For 3D Medical Image Segmentation
core_mech: GSC + Tri-oriented Mamba 的 TSMamba block，以及 FUE 过滤的多尺度 skip。
core_mech_en: Combines Gated Spatial Convolution (GSC) with Tri-oriented Mamba (ToM) scans along axial, coronal, and sagittal axes plus Feature Uncertainty Estimation (FUE) skips.
output_desc: 多尺度融合的 3D 分割

adapter.name: SegMamba (spatial scan mechanism)
adapter.mechanism: Gated spatial convolution branches and three sequence scan orders inside a volumetric skip network.
limitations: Random initialization and synthetic data; no original benchmark result or pretrained capability is reproduced.
The three-order scan is a pedagogical analogue, not the authors' BiMamba-v3/fast-slice kernel or complete SegMamba architecture.
